replies.author: Hete
replies.body:
The map it self is WAY too simple. There is no area to pvp on. I suggest you make a flat land, and put structures on it.

For the kits you have provided, that would be the best thing to do in my opinion.

replies.author: TheMasterCow
replies.body:
Pics And btw why can't avicus make the maps instead of us?
Avicus isn't a person and we have the community submit maps so we're more open and get a taste of everything. If we did even, the staff team would be too busy and we'd miss out on lots of great builders.

Regarding your map, it's just too basic. There's no room to PvP and it's small. It's denied, sorry.

replies.author: TheMasterCow
replies.body:
[Denied] - I apologize, but your map has been denied for use on the Avicus Network and will not appear in either repository or rotations. Your map has been denied for the following reasons --
→ Too plain. How could you make it look more appealing?
→ Too small. Could you expand the size?
→ Too restricted. Could you add more room to fight?
→ Too flat. Could you add more terrain or some more structure?
→ Poor PvP gear. Do you think gear as such is good for this map?
→ Poor middle gear. Don't you think strength II is too overpowered?
→ Too blocky. Could you add more shape into it?
→ Lacks creativity. Is it similar to another map? Is it unique?
→ Chokepoint. Could you add more ways to get around?
